notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {5}{G}.
easyPrerequisites:
Elder Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Benefactor's Draught exiled by Isochron Scepter.
description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Elder Druid by paying {3}{G} and tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.
